day2_afternoon_class.name: Me
day2_afternoon_class.text: *School's finally over. The red sunset filtering through the window paints the classroom in a sentimental glow. Is it free time now...?*

day2_afternoon_nurse_skip.name: Me
day2_afternoon_nurse_skip.text: *I wake up on the infirmary bed to find the sun setting. I skipped all my classes, but waking up after a long nap next to the teacher makes my body feel light.*

day2_after_school.name: Me
day2_after_school.text: *The hallway feels much more familiar than yesterday. What kind of heart-pounding moments are waiting for me today? Let's go where my heart leads.*
choices: Go find Seoyeon to watch the sunset together.
Dive into the school's deep secrets with Yuna.
Search for Yuna, the mysterious girl who left the note.
Go help Dain practice, her sweat beads looking beautiful.
Head to the lively gym, searching for Dain's voice.
Talk more with the teacher who took care of me.
Go to the infirmary, scented with faint medicine, to see the teacher.
Head to the faculty room to see my kind homeroom teacher.

day2_after_nurse_stay.name: Me
day2_after_nurse_stay.text: *I headed back to the infirmary. The nurse is still sitting in her seat.*

day2_after_seoyeon.name: Me
day2_after_seoyeon.text: *Student Council Room. I started helping Seoyeon organize documents. She kindly explains the work to me, a newcomer.*

day2_after_seoyeon_work.name: Me
day2_after_seoyeon_work.text: *Lost in work with Seoyeon, the window outside is bathed in crimson sunset light. The room is filled only with our breathing and the sound of paper.*

day2_after_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
day2_after_seoyeon_2.text: "Phew... finished at last. {name}, thank you so much for helping this much. I wouldn't have finished this today without you."

day2_after_seoyeon_3.name: Me
day2_after_seoyeon_3.text: *Seoyeon stretches with a soft smile. She looks tired, but her eyes are clearer and more beautiful than ever.*
choices: Seoyeon, why are you always so sincere and hardworking?
Let's rest now. I'll make sure to walk you home.
Your shoulders look tense. Here, stay still for a second.

day2_seoyeon_why.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_why.text: "Well... it's just something that needs to be done. And I hope that if I do my best, the school might improve, even if just a little."

day2_seoyeon_home_high.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_home_high.text: "Really...? (Seoyeon smiles brightly and gently takes my arm) Honestly, I wanted to walk with you, {name}. The sunset is so beautiful..."

day2_seoyeon_home.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_home.text: "Oh...? Walk me home? Ah... well, I'd be very grateful if you did..."

day2_seoyeon_home_low.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_home_low.text: "Oh.. it's okay, I can go alone. Thanks for helping today though."

day2_seoyeon_massage_high.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_massage_high.text: "Mmm... {name}... (Seoyeon happily closes her eyes and leans into it) That feels so good... I didn't know your hands were so warm. Just a little more..."

day2_seoyeon_massage.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_massage.text: "Ah... {name}! So suddenly... (She flinches for a moment, but soon relaxes and closes her eyes) ...That feels great. Thank you."

day2_seoyeon_massage_low.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_massage_low.text: *Seoyeon quickly pulls away, looking uncomfortable* "What was that...? It's a bit uncomfortable."

day2_seoyeon_night_talk.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_night_talk.text: "{name}... thank you so much for today. When I'm with you, all my tired thoughts vanish. Should we... have lunch together tomorrow too?"

day2_seoyeon_dain_encounter.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_dain_encounter.text: *As we leave the student council room together, we bump into someone in the corridor.*

day2_seoyeon_dain_met.name: Dain
day2_seoyeon_dain_met.text: "Oh? You're the one from the snack bar earlier! {name}! Wow, hanging out with the student council president?"

day2_seoyeon_dain_new.text: "Huh? Are you the transfer student? Whoa, already friends with the council president?"

day2_seoyeon_dain_react.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_dain_react.text: "(Seoyeon looks slightly flustered) ...Dain, right? Hi. We just finished work, so we were heading out."

day2_seoyeon_dain_choice.name: Dain
day2_seoyeon_dain_choice.text: "Oh, really? I just finished practice! {name}, hang out with me next time too!"
choices: Sure, definitely!
I have plans with Seoyeon today, so...
*Smile vaguely* It'd be nice to hang out with both of you.

day2_seoyeon_dain_no.name: Dain
day2_seoyeon_dain_no.text: "Aww, that's disappointing. But promise me next time!"

day2_seoyeon_dain_both.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_dain_both.text: *Both Seoyeon's and Dain's expressions freeze at the same time. Did I say something wrong...?*

day2_seoyeon_dain_both_2.name: Dain
day2_seoyeon_dain_both_2.text: "...What? Both of us? What's that supposed to mean?"

day2_seoyeon_dain_both_3.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_dain_both_3.text: "(Seoyeon smiles coldly) Heh... {name} sure is popular, huh? The type who says yes to everyone, I guess."

day2_seoyeon_dain_both_4.name: Dain
day2_seoyeon_dain_both_4.text: "Oh come on, Miss President. But she's got a point though? {name}, you might end up losing both of us like that."

day2_seoyeon_dain_both_5.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_dain_both_5.text: *The two of them exchange glances while staring at me. The atmosphere just got really awkward...*

day2_seoyeon_dain_end.name: Me
day2_seoyeon_dain_end.text: *Dain waves and walks away. Seoyeon's expression seems slightly stiff for some reason.*

day2_seoyeon_contact_ask.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_contact_ask.text: "Oh, right! I haven't asked for your contact info yet. I have a feeling I'll keep wanting to talk to you... Can I have your number?"
choices: Sure, contact me anytime. Here's my number.
Sorry, I'll give it to you when we're a bit closer.

day2_seoyeon_contact_success.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_contact_success.text: "Thank you! I'll definitely message you later. Get home safe!"

day2_seoyeon_contact_fail.name: Seoyeon
day2_seoyeon_contact_fail.text: "Oh... right! I asked too suddenly, didn't I? Sorry. See you at school tomorrow!"

day2_after_yuna.name: Me
day2_after_yuna.text: *Library Annex. As I enter the old building, a cool draft of air surrounds me.*

day2_after_yuna_met.name: Yuna
day2_after_yuna_met.text: "You're here. Come, follow me. I have something to show you."

day2_after_yuna_new.text: "You... you came because you're curious about me, right? This school hides a very deep secret."

day2_after_yuna_new_follow.name: Yuna
day2_after_yuna_new_follow.text: "{name}... I'll remember that. Come, follow me. I have something to show only you."

day2_after_yuna_follow_again.name: Me
day2_after_yuna_follow_again.text: *I follow Yuna back down to the basement warehouse. The air feels even colder than before. The sunset glow fades as we descend into the shadows.*

day2_after_yuna_follow_new.name: Me
day2_after_yuna_follow_new.text: *I follow Yuna down to a dusty warehouse in the basement. A strange chill hangs in the air. The sunset light barely reaches this deep.*

day2_after_yuna_3_pre_again.name: Yuna
day2_after_yuna_3_pre_again.text: "Those symbols we saw earlier... what do you think now? Don't they look even more eerie in this dim light?"

day2_after_yuna_3_pre_new.name: Yuna
day2_after_yuna_3_pre_new.text: "Look, {name}. These patterns on the wall... they match the secrets of this school I've been tracking."

day2_after_yuna_3.name: Me
day2_after_yuna_3.text: *Yuna points to a crack in the wall. A strange, eye-like symbol is drawn there in reddish ink.*
choices: What does this even mean?
*Taking Yuna's hand* It's scary, let's get out of here.
This eye... it feels like it's watching us.

day2_yuna_meaning.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_meaning.text: "Surveillance... or protection. I still don't know who it's for."

day2_yuna_scary_high.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_scary_high.text: *Yuna holds my hand tightly and smiles softly.* "...Your hand is warm. It's been a long time since I felt such warmth. Okay, let's go. But... don't let go of my hand."

day2_yuna_scary.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_scary.text: "...Your hand is warm. Okay. Let's head back for today."

day2_yuna_scary_low.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_scary_low.text: *Yuna coldly pulls her hand away.* "...Why are you grabbing my hand? Scared? You're quite bold for a coward. Leave alone if you want."

day2_yuna_eye.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_eye.text: "Correct. This school might be a giant prison or a laboratory. And we're being tested within it."

day2_yuna_night_talk.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_night_talk.text: "This isn't just graffiti. It's tied to the very purpose of this school. {name}, you've chosen a path with no turning back."

day2_yuna_nurse_encounter.name: Me
day2_yuna_nurse_encounter.text: *As we leave the warehouse with Yuna, we bump into someone in the corridor.*

day2_yuna_nurse_met.name: School Nurse
day2_yuna_nurse_met.text: "Oh my, {name}? What are you doing here at this hour? ...And who is this student?"

day2_yuna_nurse_new.text: "Hmm? Students at this hour, here? This old warehouse is dangerous... Oh, I'm the school nurse."

day2_yuna_nurse_react.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_nurse_react.text: "(Yuna speaks coldly) ...We were just passing by. Don't mind us."

day2_yuna_nurse_choice.name: School Nurse
day2_yuna_nurse_choice.text: "(The nurse looks at Yuna suspiciously) ...Is that so? Hehe, be careful. Dangerous things hide in dark places."
choices: *Hold Yuna's hand* Yes, we'll be careful.
Ma'am, we were just taking a walk.
*Just bow silently*

day2_yuna_nurse_excuse.name: School Nurse
day2_yuna_nurse_excuse.text: "Is that so? Hehe, try walking somewhere brighter next time. I worry, you know."

day2_yuna_nurse_silent.name: School Nurse
day2_yuna_nurse_silent.text: "(The nurse watches us with a suspicious look, then walks away)"

day2_yuna_nurse_end.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_nurse_end.text: "...That person feels strange. She's not just a normal school nurse. {name}, be careful."

day2_yuna_contact_ask.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_contact_ask.text: "If we're sharing secrets... we need a way to reach each other. Leave your number here."
choices: Sure. I want to know everything about you.
Sorry, I'm still a bit cautious.

day2_yuna_contact_success.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_contact_success.text: "...Done. Now we're connected. When I call... you must come, no matter what."

day2_yuna_contact_fail.name: Yuna
day2_yuna_contact_fail.text: "...Fine. I won't force you. But remember, opportunities are rare."

day2_after_dain.name: Me
day2_after_dain.text: *Opening the gym door, the energetic shouts and the sound of volleyballs bouncing greet me.*

day2_after_dain_met.name: Dain
day2_after_dain_met.text: "Oh! {name}! Perfect timing. Can you help me with practice?"

day2_after_dain_practice.name: Me
day2_after_dain_practice.text: *Helping Dain with her spikes, I'm soon drenched in sweat. Outside, it has already turned dark.*

day2_after_dain_new.text: "Haa, haa... You're so full of energy! We're perfectly in sync for our first time!"

day2_after_dain_new_name_ask.text: "I'm Dain Jung from Class 2-3! What's your name?"

day2_after_dain_3.name: Me
day2_after_dain_3.text: *Dain wipes her sweat with a towel and hands me a cold drink.*
choices: It's because you gave me such great tosses.
Should we have a real match sometime?
Tteokbokki after exercise is the best, right?

day2_dain_praise.name: Dain
day2_dain_praise.text: "Aww, don't be so modest! Anyway, thanks to you, I got some great practice in. Thanks!"

day2_dain_match.name: Dain
day2_dain_match.text: "Oh? Confident? Fine, let's make a bet! Loser buys Tteokbokki!"

day2_dain_food.name: Dain
day2_dain_food.text: "Whoa! You really get it! Tteokbokki with fried sides... man, just thinking about it makes me happy!"

day2_dain_night_talk.name: Dain
day2_dain_night_talk.text: "Wow! You're really passionate about this. I almost want to recruit you for the team! Great job today, {name}! Get home safe!"

day2_dain_yuna_encounter.name: Me
day2_dain_yuna_encounter.text: *Just then, I notice someone passing by the gym window. A pale-skinned girl walks quietly down the corridor.*

day2_dain_yuna_spot.name: Dain
day2_dain_yuna_spot.text: "(Dain looks out the window and shivers slightly) That girl... isn't she kind of creepy? She's always wandering around alone like that..."

day2_dain_yuna_choice.name: Me
choices: Yuna? She's just quiet, that's all.
Dunno, first time seeing her.
You're way brighter and better, Dain!

day2_dain_yuna_know.name: Dain
day2_dain_yuna_know.text: "Huh? You know her? Wow, {name}, you're friends with everyone. But I'm your best friend, right? Right?"

day2_dain_yuna_unknown.name: Dain
day2_dain_yuna_unknown.text: "Right? She has this different vibe... Anyway, when you're with me, focus only on me!"

day2_dain_yuna_compliment.name: Dain
day2_dain_yuna_compliment.text: "H-hey, what's with that all of a sudden?! (Dain blushes and playfully hits my shoulder) But thanks! {name}'s the best!"

day2_dain_yuna_end.name: Me
day2_dain_yuna_end.text: *Yuna disappears into the distance. Dain still seems bothered but quickly returns to her bright expression.*

day2_dain_contact_ask.name: Dain
day2_dain_contact_ask.text: "Hey, {name}! If we're going on food tours, we'll need each other's numbers, right? Punch it in!"
choices: Sure! It'll be fun to explore food places with you.
Hmm.. maybe next time.

day2_dain_contact_success.name: Dain
day2_dain_contact_success.text: "Contact saved! I'll message you as soon as I find a tasty spot, so be ready!"

day2_dain_contact_fail.name: Dain
day2_dain_contact_fail.text: "What? Playing coy? Fine, fine. I'll work harder until I get your number!"

day2_after_nurse.name: Me
day2_after_nurse.text: *Opening the infirmary door, I see the teacher reading under the gentle scent of herbs.*

day2_after_nurse_met.name: School Nurse
day2_after_nurse_met.text: "Oh, {name}. Back again? What's the trouble today? Or... did you just come to see me?"

day2_after_nurse_met_high.name: School Nurse
day2_after_nurse_met_high.text: *The teacher looks at me and smiles softly.* "Hehe, {name}. Seeing you so often makes me start to look forward to it. Come on in."

day2_after_nurse_met_check.name: School Nurse
day2_after_nurse_met_check.text: "Oh, {name}. An infirmary visit after school... is something wrong?"

day2_after_nurse_met_low.name: School Nurse
day2_after_nurse_met_low.text: *The teacher looks at me uncertainly.* "...It's {name}, right? Are you feeling unwell?"

day2_after_nurse_invited.name: School Nurse
day2_after_nurse_invited.text: "Hehe, {name}. You haven't forgotten our plan to meet at my place this evening, have you? If you're here because you missed me already, I'm truly touched."

day2_after_nurse_new.name: School Nurse
day2_after_nurse_new.text: "Oh, a new face? Are you the transfer student? I'm the school nurse."

day2_after_nurse_new_name_ask.name: School Nurse
day2_after_nurse_new_name_ask.text: "By the way, what's your name? Won't you tell me? Just between us."

day2_after_nurse_3.name: Me
day2_after_nurse_3.text: *The teacher adjusts her glasses and stares at me intently.*
choices: I came because I missed you.
I just wanted some quiet rest.
I love the scent of this room.

day2_nurse_miss.name: School Nurse
day2_nurse_miss.text: "Hehe, I like how honest you are. I should give such an honest transfer student a reward, shouldn't I?"

day2_nurse_miss_normal.name: School Nurse
day2_nurse_miss_normal.text: "Hehe, honesty is good... but saying things like that to a teacher can be misunderstood, {name}. Still, you are quite cute."

day2_nurse_miss_low.name: School Nurse
day2_nurse_miss_low.text: *The teacher looks at me coldly over her glasses.* "...I don't think we're quite on such terms yet? Student, keep your jokes appropriate. Just rest here for today."

day2_nurse_rest.name: School Nurse
day2_nurse_rest.text: "Is that so? Then go ahead and lie down on that bed. I won't disturb you."

day2_nurse_aroma.name: School Nurse
day2_nurse_aroma.text: "Oh, you have sharp senses. This is an aroma oil I blended myself. It's meant to put the mind at ease."

day2_nurse_night_talk.name: School Nurse
day2_nurse_night_talk.text: *The teacher smiles softly and strokes my hair.* "Hehe, you came because you wanted more time with me, didn't you? Fine, I'll stay with you a bit longer today, just for you."

day2_nurse_night_talk_2.name: Me
day2_nurse_night_talk_2.text: *Chatting with the teacher in the infirmary, the sunset has deepened into dusk. Regretfully, I leave the school, promising to see her again.*

day2_nurse_contact_already_have_talk.name: School Nurse
day2_nurse_contact_already_have_talk.text: "{name}, we've already exchanged numbers, haven't we? You must contact me if you're bored this evening. I'll be waiting."
choices: Yes, I will.
Instead of my number... can I go to your house this evening?

nurse_contact_home_success_after.name: School Nurse
nurse_contact_home_success_after.text: *The teacher's eyes widen, then she whispers in my ear with a seductive smile.* "Oh... {name}, you're much bolder than I thought. Fine, want to come to my house this evening? I'll send you the address. But... it's a secret from your parents, okay?"

nurse_contact_home_fail_after.name: School Nurse
nurse_contact_home_fail_after.text: *The teacher bursts into laughter.* "Oh my, {name}! You're so cute. But my house is a bit too early, isn't it? Just message me later."

day2_nurse_contact_ask.name: School Nurse
day2_nurse_contact_ask.text: "{name}, why don't you save my number just in case? Contact me anytime you're sick or need someone to talk to."
choices: Yes, please!
It's a bit much for now.

day2_nurse_contact_success.name: School Nurse
day2_nurse_contact_success.text: "Hehe, good boy. Then I'll message you later. Have a good evening, {name}."

day2_nurse_contact_fail.name: School Nurse
day2_nurse_contact_fail.text: "Oh, playing hard to get? Fine. Let me know if you change your mind. Get home safe!"

day2_after_teacher.name: Me
day2_after_teacher.text: *Opening the faculty room door, I see the homeroom teacher working alone under a desk lamp in the empty office.*

day2_after_teacher_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day2_after_teacher_2.text: "Oh, {name}? What brings you here at this hour? Haven't you gone home yet?"

day2_after_teacher_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
day2_after_teacher_3.text: "I have quite a few documents to submit this week... Hehe, I'm showing you such a haggard side of me since your first week."
choices: I'll help you. We'll finish much faster together!
Hang in there! Should I make you a cup of coffee?
Teacher, don't overwork yourself. I'm worried.

day2_after_teacher_work.name: Me
day2_after_teacher_work.text: *I sat next to the teacher and started helping her sort the papers. Only the rhythmic sound of turning pages fills the quiet office.*

day2_after_teacher_work_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day2_after_teacher_work_2.text: "Thank you, {name}. You've been a huge help. I would've been here much longer if I were alone."

day2_after_teacher_branch.name: Me
day2_after_teacher_branch.text: *The teacher looks at me quietly, seemingly lost in thought.*

day2_after_teacher_special.name: Homeroom Teacher
day2_after_teacher_special.text: *The teacher suddenly leans in toward me. I can feel her warm breath and the faint scent of her perfume.*

day2_after_teacher_special_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day2_after_teacher_special_2.text: "{name}, I think you're a truly special student. It's only been two days... why do I feel so comfortable, as if we've known each other for years?"

day2_after_teacher_special_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
day2_after_teacher_special_3.text: "As a reward for helping today... I'll drive you home. Shall we talk more in the car?"

day2_after_teacher_normal.name: Homeroom Teacher
day2_after_teacher_normal.text: "Well, it's late, so you should head home. I'll finish up and leave, too. You did a great job today!"

day2_after_teacher_coffee.name: Homeroom Teacher
day2_after_teacher_coffee.text: "Oh, coffee? Hehe, thank you for the thought. But I can't have a student prepare it for me. I'll give you a delicious candy instead!"

day2_after_teacher_worry.name: Homeroom Teacher
day2_after_teacher_worry.text: "Thank you for worrying about me. I'm okay! I feel so reassured because {name} is such a kind student."
